description:
Skills: authoritative guidance for kinds of work (outdoor lighting, art styles, PCG graphs, building, game logic).
Call list_skills when starting a task, then get_skills for the ones that apply, and follow them.
Projects add their own as Blueprint/C++ skills (URuntimeAgentSkill) or markdown files in Config/RuntimeToolsets/Skills
(front matter "description: ..." then the instructions). Agents save what they learn with save_skill.
name: skills

tools.description:
Deletes a skill saved with save_skill (built-in skills cannot be deleted).
This cannot be undone: only call it after explicit direction or permission from the user.
tools.name: skills.delete_skill

tools.description:
Returns the full instructions of the given skills. Skills can be long (game_logic is the whole logic guide): load one or two per call.
Returns: Skill name -> details. Fails if no name is given or a skill does not exist (the error lists the skills).
tools.name: skills.get_skills

instructions.description: How to approach the task: rules, numbers, workflow (markdown).

returnValue.description: Skill name -> details. Fails if no name is given or a skill does not exist (the error lists the skills).

tools.description:
Lists every skill with a one-line description of when to apply it.
Returns: Skill name -> description.
tools.name: skills.list_skills

tools.description:
Saves a skill for future agents (a markdown file in Config/RuntimeToolsets/Skills; saving the same name updates it). Do this after finishing a task that needed several fixes: write the working recipe (order of steps, exact argument shapes that worked, numbers, gotchas and how you verified it), not a story of the session.
Returns: Path of the saved file. Fails if the name is not snake_case, belongs to a built-in skill, or the text is empty.

description.description: One line starting "Apply when ...", shown by list_skills so agents know when to load it.

tools.name: skills.save_skill

returnValue.description: Path of the saved file. Fails if the name is not snake_case, belongs to a built-in skill, or the text is empty.
